name: T11-freezer
description: Cached-app freezer applied ~10s after backgrounding, matching the OS's own timing.

steps.why: clear the minimum-upload-interval gate; without this the ON_STOP upload is debounced and the run measures the debounce instead of the question
matches the ~10s the OS itself waits before freezing a cached process
after the freeze, timed flushes should stop entirely — that absence is the signal
